preamble.title: Autonomous Reliability Platform — 40 Domains / 800 Production Failure Scenarios
preamble.purpose: Seed an incident taxonomy and detection/remediation design for cross-industry services. These are plausible failure hypotheses, not a complete list of all possible production failures.
preamble.use_safely: Instrument first; run synthetic fault-injection and chaos tests only in authorized environments. Start AI agents in read-only diagnostic mode. Require approval for money movement, destructive data changes, privilege changes, security incidents, legal/compliance determinations, physical controls, and patient or public safety.
preamble.field_guide: detection signal = observable failure pattern; telemetry/test = instrumentable evidence; likely causes = hypotheses, not conclusions; automation policy = baseline approval gate; verification = independent post-action check. Severity values are starting defaults, to be calibrated to impact and blast radius.
preamble.shared_reliability_foundation: Besides these domain cases, implement cross-cutting checks for availability, latency, saturation, errors, distributed traces, queue age/dead-letter queues, duplicate messages, idempotency, DB transaction invariants, backup restore, schema compatibility, feature flags, permissions, data freshness, and secret rotation. A domain checklist alone cannot detect unknown failures.

closing.heading: Implementation guidance
guidance_items: Model incidents as observations, hypotheses, experiments, actions, verification and audit artifacts.
Bind every candidate detector to real event schemas, business invariants, sample payloads, service owners and severity thresholds.
Correlate error spikes with releases and dependency incidents; avoid assuming the first matching detector gives the root cause.
Keep AI diagnostic reasoning separate from deterministic policy enforcement, approvals and remediation execution.
Use sandbox replay, canary and fault-injection validation; never use live data or financial/physical actions as exploratory tests.
Measure precision, recall, MTTD, MTTR, false positive rate and bad-remediation rate per domain.

scenarios.title: Duplicate payment capture
scenarios.detection_description: Event, request or ledger counts diverge; scenario-specific sentinel: duplicate payment capture.
scenarios.instrumentation_description: Reconciliation query; idempotency-key collision and uniqueness metrics; compare affected entity IDs and last-known-good state.
scenarios.likely_causes: Retries without durable idempotency; concurrent updates
scenarios.triage_description: Identify affected fintech entities; correlate deployment/change history; determine blast radius; verify system-of-record invariants.
scenarios.potential_remediation: Pause affected financial mutations; reconcile authoritative ledger and seek authorized approval before reversals, refunds, settlement, or balance changes.
scenarios.verification_description: Recheck duplicate payment capture against independent source of truth; confirm error/SLO and integrity signals recover; monitor for recurrence.
